يمتطيا (form VIII)
# يَمْتَطِيَا (yamtaṭiyā) /jam.ta.tˤi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
# يُمْتَطَيَا (yumtaṭayā) /jum.ta.tˤa.jaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَطَى (imtaṭā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
